plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Recreation - Leisure Services Degree BS checklist (Catalog Year: 2026-2027), updated 04/11/2026. This is a degree checklist with a 'Suggested Scheduling Guide' rather than the standard HSU 8-semester-plan template; the term-by-term guide is transcribed. Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 13+15+13+13+15+12+14+14+6+6 = 121; all printed semester totals reconcile with the course rows (the checklist is not built on the 120-hour template and its guide genuinely sums to 121). QUIRKS KEPT VERBATIM: the scheduling guide prints 'RESM 3273' (Marketing & Fundraising Rec & Sport), 'RESM 4053' (Evaluation & Research in Rec & Sport), 'RESM 2213' (Intro Outdoor Recreation), and 'RESM 42103' (Corporate Wellness) - each recorded exactly as printed even though the checklist core lists number them RESM 32703, RESM 40503, RESM 22103, and RESM 42003. The 1-hour 'NATURAL SCIENCE (SEE LAC REQ)' slots correspond to the science lab hour. 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed code. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course.
